about: I’m Kristina Arizanović, the trainer behind Arizona Lifts. I’m a licensed fitness trainer offering personal training and online coaching. A political science graduate on paper, but a fitness trainer at heart.

My love for fitness began five years ago, when I was struggling with excess weight and low confidence. I know how much determination and discipline change takes. Training changed me, both physically and mentally.

I’ve been a fitness trainer for over three years and have helped more than 100 people build their physique, strength, and confidence. My goal is to teach you how to train smart, eat without guilt, and enjoy the process.

Today, my coaching brings together my education, personal experience, and work with clients. I earned my certification through Savez za fitnes i rekreaciju Srbije, Serbia’s fitness and recreation federation.
I’m here to help you reach your goal, find joy in training, and build habits that last.

audience.title: Training for weight-loss goals
audience.text: Looking for a personal trainer to support your weight-loss goals? Together, we build a training plan that fits your starting point and routine. Weekly check-ins help us review progress and adjust the plan, without promises of a fixed result or deadline.

audience.title: Shape and strength
audience.text: Through strength training, we work on building muscle and reducing body fat — body recomposition. The focus is on progress, technique, and how you feel in your body.

audience.title: Strength training for beginners
audience.text: New to strength training or returning after a break? Start with a plan suited to your experience, exercise demonstrations and technique feedback. We build confidence and a sustainable training routine step by step.

steps.title: Start a conversation
steps.text: Choose a package and contact me on Instagram or by email. We’ll talk about your goal, whether that’s weight loss, body recomposition, or building a sustainable routine, and find the support that fits you.

steps.title: Assess and plan
steps.text: Your starting point, goals, and capabilities shape your personalized training plan in the app and seven-day meal plan.

steps.title: Train with guidance
steps.text: Follow the exercise demonstrations and send training clips for technique feedback at your weekly check-in. Advanced and Premium also include messaging support between check-ins.

steps.title: Check in and adjust
steps.text: Regular weekly check-ins track progress. Your plan is adjusted to your progress and commitments.

faq.q: Can I start strength training with an online personal trainer?
faq.a: Online coaching starts with a review of your experience, goals and available equipment. Your plan includes exercise demonstrations, and we review your technique through training videos at weekly check-ins. Tell me if you are a complete beginner so we can discuss the support you need before choosing a package.

faq.q: Can I train at home, and what equipment do I need?
faq.a: Tell Kristina where you plan to train and what equipment you have when you get in touch. Discuss whether the plan can fit your setup before choosing a package.

faq.q: How do check-ins and technique reviews work?
faq.a: Every online package includes weekly progress check-ins, video technique reviews, and plan adjustments during those check-ins. Advanced and Premium also include messaging support between weekly check-ins.

Basic includes a personalized seven-day meal plan, a nutrition handbook with over 100 recipes, an e-book on carbohydrates, and a wellness journal. Advanced and Premium also include tracking your eating habits with specific guidance.

faq.q: What is the difference between Basic, Advanced, and Premium?
faq.a: Basic includes personalized training, nutrition resources, and support through weekly check-ins. Advanced adds messaging support between check-ins, eating-habit guidance, and one individual 30-minute video consultation per month. Premium includes everything in Advanced plus one in-person training session.

faq.q: Where does in-person training take place?
faq.a: Contact Kristina to confirm the training location, availability, and session arrangements before booking. This also applies to the in-person session included in Premium.
Select “Ask about mentorship” on a package, then choose Instagram or email. The email option includes the package name in the subject so you can discuss the right support with Kristina.

faq.q: What is the difference between online coaching and in-person personal training?
faq.a: With online coaching, you follow your training plan in the app and send videos for technique feedback at weekly check-ins. Advanced and Premium also include messaging between check-ins. With in-person personal training, we work together during the session so I can guide your technique as you train. Contact me to confirm the location and availability.

faq.q: Can personal training support my weight-loss goals?
faq.a: Weight loss can be one of the goals we discuss when creating your training plan. We review your starting point and progress at weekly check-ins and adjust training to your commitments. Results and timelines vary from person to person; the focus is on consistent training and habits you can maintain.
